Bluetooth is used only for the selected rotor. Android 12+ requires Bluetooth scan/connect. Android 8–11 requires precise location to scan BLE and may require phone Location enabled. We do not obtain or upload phone location. Internet only downloads TLEs using HTTPS from the three listed providers; no analytics.

Calibration · phase %1$d/4
1. Check clearance, limits, physical emergency stop and power. Press Homing. Wait for homed status; homing establishes AZ=-180°, EL=0°, not true north.
2. Level the base with an instrument. Move manually to a safe reference with EL=0. Verify the output/antenna zero, not only motor readings.

3. Measure the CURRENT true antenna heading using a geographic/solar reference or a compass corrected for declination and away from metal. Stationary GNSS does NOT measure heading. Do not use a false GPS heading.
4. Enter the measured heading and confirm level/zero. Saved phase is guidance, not calibration: authenticated rotor status is authoritative. Rehome/reboot requires new calibration.

APRS radio message preparation

This is amateur-radio APRS messaging between callsigns, not cellular SMS and not APRS-IS. No encrypted message content. Enter your licensed station callsign-SSID, a recipient callsign, optional verified digipeater path (blank is allowed), 1–67 printable characters, and optional 1–5 character message ID. Prepare creates AX.25 UI/FCS/HDLC/NRZI Bell 202 audio for manual isolated bench use. It does NOT key a transmitter. Direct radio send is disabled until a verified transport/PTT design is approved. A saved WAV is prepared audio only; it has not been transmitted or acknowledged. Never play it into a microphone or use automatic PTT.
